_description: Osculating heliocentric orbital inclination (IN, deg), ascending node (OM, deg) and eccentricity (EC, dimensionless) in the ecliptic-J2000 frame for the eight planets (planetary-system barycenters 1-8, center 500@10), from the NASA/JPL Horizons API (DE441), BC 9998-01-01 to AD 9999-01-01 at 100-year steps. Reference overlay for the Formula Verification "Inclination of all planets" and "Eccentricity of all planets" charts. Horizons output is a US-government work (public domain). Fetched 2026-09-15 via https://ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/api/horizons.api (EPHEM_TYPE=ELEMENTS, REF_PLANE=ECLIPTIC, REF_SYSTEM=J2000).
